title: Breaks and holds
description: Let staff stop a learner’s reminders for a while, or pause an enrolment, from the learner’s Membership tab.

hold.title: Reminder hold
hold.point1: For a short absence, or a payment promised for later.
hold.point2: Class and/or fee reminders stop until the last day.
hold.point3: The learner stays enrolled, keeps paying and can still join classes.

pause.title: Pause
pause.point1: For a long break when the learner does not pay meanwhile.
pause.point2: No charges, renewals or expiry; the course can be switched off.
pause.point3: On return, the membership dates move forward by the days paused.

audit: Every break is recorded on the learner’s timeline and in the activity log, with who made it and when.
offNote: Switching this off stops new breaks. Breaks already running continue until they end.
